summary: The ConfidentialityForms module is part of an enrollment management system. It handles the display and management of confidentiality forms for students. This system includes functionality for managing form data, selecting or deselecting forms, grid view controls for data presentation, and actions for saving, editing, and updating entries.
purpose: To manage and display student confidentiality forms, allowing user interactions such as viewing, editing, and saving these forms within an enrollment system.

workflows.name: Form Management
steps: Display confidentiality forms in a grid view.
Allow the user to select or deselect forms using buttons.
Provide options for editing form details through a popup modal.
Enable saving changes to form details.

business_rules: Data fields are auto-generated and should not be modified directly.
Changes to the auto-generated fields may be lost upon regeneration.
validations: Ensure Email field is not empty when enabling related controls.
Verify date received is entered when saving form entries.
conditions: If a form is waived, disable further actions on it.
Forms in read-only mode do not allow edits.
system_behavior: Auto-updates the grid view upon changes to form entries.
Executes JavaScript to manage UI elements like checkboxes and dropdowns.
